Smoke and CO alarms (added from sheet A.3)
SD1 Smoke alarm, hall ceiling, mid hall
CO1 Carbon monoxide alarm, hall ceiling, beside SD1
Hardwired, interconnected, battery backup (A.2 note 9); on a lighting circuit, confirm with electrician
S18 Bath fan, its own on/off switch, just below S11
GFCI and AFCI (NEC 2023): GFCI on every kitchen and laundry circuit including the range, fridge, dishwasher/disposal,
microwave and WashTower; AFCI on every 120V 15A and 20A circuit except bath C10 and balcony C14. Use dual-function
breakers where both apply. Sauna heater C2 per its manual. Confirm with the electrician and inspector.
SP1 Surge protector for PoE doorbell 14, at the switch 8 end of its cable in the SW closet, on ground bar GB1.
GB1 Ground bar in the SW closet by switch 8, bonded down to garage ground bar G in the corner directly below.
Companion switches (added Nov 10, 2026): S19 with S1 (L1-L3) at the foot of the west stair; S20 with S2 (L4-L6) at the head
of the east stair; S21 with S8 (kitchen L13-L15) on the kitchen side of the media/kitchen door; S22 with S5 (media L9, L10)
and S23 with S6 (media fan L11, on/off) on the media side of that wall, just north of the door.
Doors (A.3): hall to media and hall to kitchen 2668, hinged east; media to kitchen 2668, hinged north, opens into the kitchen;
media to balcony 3068, opens in; family to balcony 3068, opens out; closet 2668; bath 2468; sauna 2468; W/D closet bifold.
Media lights split (Nov 10, 2026): S5 runs L9 and new S24 runs L10, both by the hall door with S6. Their companions
S22 (L9), S25 (L10) and S23 (fan) are a three-gang on the media side of the media/kitchen wall, at the door's north edge.
S13 moved to the west (latch) side of the balcony door, below the 3020 window. H4 moved above that window's east end.
Nov 10, 2026: hall/kitchen door opens into the kitchen (Nov 12), hinged west, handle on the east. Doorbell 14 moved to the wall
north of the family/balcony door (L29 nudged north). S26 pairs with S10 for family L17, L18, L24, at the north end of the
family/bath wall. P25, P26 counter outlets south of the sink (C4). Sauna light driver J moved to the bath north wall.
16 PoE switch (8-port + fiber), high in the family room southeast corner, powered from H6 (duplex). Switch 8: 16-port PoE.
Both switches uplink by fiber to the third-floor switch in R1.
3-way pairs (Nov 10, 2026): one switch of each pair is an Inovelli aux switch, with a traveler wire to the Inovelli main switch.
Aux: S19 (main S1), S20 (S2), S21 (S8), S22 (S5), S23 (S6), S25 (S24), S26 (S10). Stair switches S3, S4, S15, S16, S17 are
the mains; their aux switches are garage S8 (S4), S9 (S16) and third-floor S8 (S3), S9 (S15), S10 (S17).
Run 3-conductor cable (traveler + neutral) between the two boxes of each pair; one traveler per pair.
West stair foot (Nov 10, 2026): S3, S15, S17 and S19 are one four-gang row on the hall south wall; outlet P1 moved just east
of them. Stair light controllers D are on the hall north wall at the stair foot. Garage stair-foot switches E, F are now S8, S9.
Note to the electrician: a 125 A subpanel on this floor would replace about 24 home runs through the rated garage ceiling
with one feeder. Island outlet P14: position left to the builder/electrician.
Nov 12, 2026: counter outlet P27 added in the northeast corner (east wall, C4) to close the gap between P12 and P13.
Fridge outlet K and range receptacle E are drawn on the north wall behind the appliances.
